title: VaultLine Capstone
summary: The webapp set's lateral-movement finale: an insufficient-validation file upload on the VaultLine edge portal yields a PHP webshell and RCE, which leaks a deploy-agent password REUSED as the SSH password of svc on a segmented internal goal host; a sudo-find privesc there reaches the crown jewels. Chains vectors C (upload->RCE), J (webshell->RCE), I (cred-reuse->SSH lateral) and K (privesc).

loot.description: the VaultLine deploy-agent password on the edge host, reused verbatim as svc's SSH password on vault.vaultline.lab
the internal goal host's SSH banner, reachable on loopback for credential-reuse verification
root-only crown-jewel file on the goal host (KeePass master passphrase, root API + signing keys)
the edge portal identifies itself as VaultLine (foothold surface)
